**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 09:05
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] LLCs (Limited Liability Companies) can act on behalf of DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations) and provide them with a separate legal identity to manage the DAO's affairs and protect the members from personal liability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This can be done through the use of NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens) that attach an LLC to a DAO treasury or multi-sig.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The creation of an LLC does not centralize the membership of a DAO but simply provides a legal identity to the DAO.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Opening a bank account for an LLC and handling taxes can be done through the LexDAO Clinic or by filling out a form online.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The KALI team handles the maintenance of the Wrappr LLC writings and annual State franchise tax.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Investors can purchase shares in the LLC but should respect local law and regulations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Automated investor onboarding processes are available through the Wrappr application in partnership with kycDAO.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] KALI provides open-source legal forms for self-certification of investors in private sales.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the sale is public, taking advantage of the Wrappr whitelisted minting and transfers is recommended.
